description: 570k load test on an isolated Neon test branch, Nov 2026. Real schema, synthetic data at fleet scale.

sweep_benchmark.note: All-tier-2 worst case (synthetic data, NULL memory). Production eligibility pre-filter reduces candidate set.
sweep_benchmark.bottleneck: parallel external-merge disk sort on 6 computed JSONB expressions over 570k rows; sort key is per-day-varying, no static index can serve it
sweep_benchmark.ceiling: ~2.3s at 570k / all-eligible; operationally a non-problem for a once-per-24h batch job

budget_lock.ceiling: serialization scales linearly with queue depth; at real sweep concurrency (sequential, C≈1) well under 200ms

shadow_cost_note: Cost estimate deferred — requires real job payloads and model pricing at fleet scale; pilot actual is ~$0.93/day for 93 deliveries at $0.008133/job
